organizations.publicNote: German recording company active from 1925 to 1972; the linked discs use Electrola as their imprint. In 1972 Electrola-Gesellschaft and Carl Lindström GmbH were merged into the successor company EMI Electrola. The designation E.G. belongs to a record series, not to the organization’s name.

sources.fullCitation: Marek Weber und sein Orchester, with vocal refrain. “Du bist in meinem Leben die erste Sensation.” Tango; label credits Jurmann and Kaper, with words by Fritz Rotter. Electrola E.G. 2508, label number 60-1903. Disc label shown in the YouTube transfer published by Brillantspecial; the uploader identifies the vocalist as John Hendrik.
sources.title: Du bist in meinem Leben die erste Sensation — Electrola E.G. 2508
sources.creator: Marek Weber und sein Orchester; John Hendrik, vocal refrain (uploader attribution)
sources.researchNote: The label displayed in the video identifies the title, Jurmann and Kaper, lyricist Fritz Rotter, Marek Weber und sein Orchester, Electrola E.G. 2508 and the printed number 60-1903. It indicates a vocal refrain but does not name the singer. John Hendrik is named in the upload title, not on the label. An earlier archive note gave matrix E-OD 795 / I and the recording date 17 February 1932, but these details are not established by the displayed label and require independent verification. Henry König’s Electrola list associates E.G. 2508 with other titles; the displayed label is direct evidence for this side, but the discrepancy in the list has not been resolved. The Tangos78rpm entry links to this same upload and is not independent evidence for the transfer.
